passage.label: Al-Baqarah — command to worship, challenge to produce a surah, description of Paradise

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ

ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِرَٰشٗا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءٗ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزۡقٗا لَّكُمۡۖ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
وَإِن كُنتُمۡ فِي رَيۡبٖ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا فَأۡتُواْ بِسُورَةٖ مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ وَٱدۡعُواْ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
فَإِن لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَلَن تَفۡعَلُواْ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُۖ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ

وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُواْ مِنۡهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٖ رِّزۡقٗا قَالُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي رُزِقۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَأُتُواْ بِهِۦ مُتَشَٰبِهٗاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

mainSubject.label: Command to all mankind to worship the Creator; challenge to produce a surah like the Quran; warning of Hellfire; glad tidings of Paradise for believers

subordinateSubjects.label: Universal address to mankind commanding worship of the Lord who created them
Allah as the one who made earth a resting place and sky a canopy
Sending down rain and bringing forth fruits as provision
Prohibition against setting up equals (andad) with Allah
Challenge to produce a single surah like the revelation if in doubt
Calling witnesses other than Allah to support the challenge
Declaration of inability to meet the challenge (lan taf'aloo)
Warning to fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones
Fire prepared specifically for the disbelievers
Glad tidings of gardens beneath which rivers flow for believers who do righteous deeds
Fruit provision in Paradise recognized as resembling prior provision

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Taqwa as the intended outcome of worship
Doubt (rayb) regarding revelation as condition triggering the challenge
Truthfulness (sadiqeen) as condition for making the challenge
Faith combined with righteous action as condition for Paradise

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Natural world (earth, sky, rain, fruit) as signs of divine provision

relationships.label: Continuity of creation across generations (those before you)

notes: Pass A pilot 3, passage 4/4. Contains first direct command to all mankind, first challenge (tahaddi), first description of Jannah and Jahannam in Al-Baqarah.
